title: AutoDCA
tagline: AutoDCA, the Decentralized Investment Planner (DIP), empowers users for seamless, trustless crypto investments on Ethereum. Smart contracts automate personalized plans, managing token selection, frequency, and total commitment. Experience secure, user-friendly investing with DIP!
description:
Decentralized Investment Planner (DIP)

DIP is a blockchain-powered investment planning platform built on the Ethereum network. With DIP, users can seamlessly create and execute personalized investment plans using smart contracts. Tailored for crypto enthusiasts, DIP allows users to define parameters such as token selection, investment frequency, and total commitment, automating the execution of their investment strategies. Say goodbye to manual trading hassles – DIP brings simplicity and security to decentralized investing."
how_its_made:
DIP is crafted using Ethereum's smart contract technology, ensuring a secure and transparent investment experience. The backend smart contract, written in Solidity, enables users to create and execute investment plans effortlessly. The decentralized nature of blockchain ensures tamper-proof execution, eliminating the need for intermediaries.

On the frontend, a Next.js and TypeScript-powered web interface provides an intuitive user experience. Ethers.js library facilitates seamless interaction with the Ethereum blockchain, allowing users to connect their wallets, create personalized investment plans, and execute them with ease.

The entire DIP ecosystem promotes financial autonomy, providing users with a trustless and efficient investment solution for the decentralized era
